description: This file contains TypeScript declarations for the BSON library, including class definitions, functions, interfaces, and constants used for BSON serialization, deserialization, and BSON types such as Binary, ObjectId, UUID, Long, Timestamp, and more. It defines the structure and type information for BSON data manipulation in TypeScript projects.

classes.name: Binary
classes.description: Represents the BSON Binary type, encapsulating binary data with a subtype. Provides methods for reading, writing, and creating binary data in various formats, including vectors and bits.

classes.name: ObjectId
classes.description: Represents the BSON ObjectId type, a unique identifier used in MongoDB documents. Includes methods for creation, validation, and conversion to string formats.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: Represents the universal unique identifier (UUID) BSON type, with methods for creation, validation, and conversion from/to string and binary formats.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: Represents a 64-bit integer supporting signed and unsigned values with methods for comparison, arithmetic operations, and conversions.

classes.name: Timestamp
classes.description: Represents the BSON Timestamp type used for internal MongoDB replication and operation ordering.

classes.name: Decimal128
classes.description: Represents the BSON Decimal128 type for high-precision decimal values, with methods for creation and string conversion.

classes.name: Double
classes.description: Represents the BSON Double type for 64-bit floating point numbers, with parsing, conversion, and inspection methods.

classes.name: Int32
classes.description: Represents the BSON 32-bit integer type with methods for parsing, conversion, and validation.

classes.name: MaxKey
classes.description: Represents the BSON MaxKey type, which compares greater than all other BSON types.

classes.name: MinKey
classes.description: Represents the BSON MinKey type, which compares less than all other BSON types.

classes.name: BSONRegExp
classes.description: Represents BSON Regular Expression type, including pattern and options.

classes.name: BSONSymbol
classes.description: Represents BSON Symbol type for deprecated symbol data.
